question: Can allow_credentials work with allow_origins=["*"] in CORSMiddleware, and what is the default?

request.query: Can allow_credentials work with allow_origins=["*"] in CORSMiddleware, and what is the default?

content.text:
### Configure CORSMiddleware in FastAPI

Source: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/cors

Registers CORSMiddleware to allow cross-origin requests from specific origins with credentials and standard HTTP methods/headers.

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

app = FastAPI()

origins = [
    "http://localhost.tiangolo.com",
    "https://localhost.tiangolo.com",
    "http://localhost",
    "http://localhost:8080",
]

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=origins,
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


@app.get("/")
async def main():
    return {"message": "Hello World"}

```

--------------------------------

### Access allow_credentials Attribute in Python

Source: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/reference/middleware

Flag indicating whether cookies and credentials are allowed in CORS requests.

```python
allow_credentials = allow_credentials

```

--------------------------------

### Access allow_origins Attribute in Python

Source: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/reference/middleware

List of origins allowed to perform cross-origin requests.

```python
allow_origins = allow_origins

```

--------------------------------

### Access allow_all_origins Attribute in Python

Source: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/reference/middleware

Flag indicating whether wildcard access is permitted across all origin domains.

```python
allow_all_origins = allow_all_origins

```

### Use CORSMiddleware

Source: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/cors

CORS can be configured in FastAPI using CORSMiddleware. Default parameters are restrictive, requiring origins, methods, or headers to be explicitly enabled for cross-domain browser requests. Configurable arguments include allow_origins, allow_origin_regex, allow_methods (defaults to GET), allow_headers (defaults to empty list), allow_credentials (defaults to False), expose_headers, and max_age (defaults to 600 seconds). If allow_credentials is set to True, wildcards cannot be used for origins, methods, or headers.
